name: Osaka Gas Co., Ltd.
summary: Osaka Gas Co., Ltd. provides natural gas, electricity, and other energy products and services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Domestic Energy, Overseas Energy, and Life & Business Solutions. The Domestic Energy Business segment manufactures, supplies, and sells city gas; sells gas appliances; installs gas pipelines; sells and transports LNG; sells LPG and industrial gas; and generates and sells electricity, as well as engineering and construction for gas and environmental facilities.
